This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.

comment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

comment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

comment.#text: Compressed air is air kept under a pressure that is greater than atmospheric pressure. It is an important medium for transfer of energy in industrial processes, and is used for power tools such as air hammers, drills, wrenches, and others. It is also used to atomize paint, to operate air cylinders for automation. Compressed air acts as an energy source for a variety of tools and machinery, and it is often an important part of many production processes.

comment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.

comment.#text: Liquid waste is a major problem globally, with it being defined as any waste material that qualifies as a 'liquid'. It is extremely hazardous as unlike solid waste, it cannot be easily removed. This waste material is classified into two types: inorganic and organic waste. It is typically generated from industrial processes such as manufacturing and power generation, and from activities like cleaning and sanitizing. It includes such liquids as wastewater, fats, oils or grease (FOG), used oil, liquids, solids, gases, sludges and hazardous household liquids.

common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it.
